definitions.explanation: A Japanese food made from white rice formed into triangular or cylindrical shapes, often wrapped in nori and containing a filling.

examples.japanese: おにぎり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧。
examples.english: Make rice balls (by shaping with hands).
examples.notes: 握る literally means to grip/grasp

examples.japanese: ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧おにぎり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a rice ball at the convenience store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧⟦{入|い}り→入り：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おにぎり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I like rice balls with pickled plum inside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遠足|えんそく}→遠足：04107_ensoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おにぎり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}ってくれた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: My mother made rice balls for my field trip lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{握|にぎ}り→握る：02383_nigiru⟧、⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{巻|ま}けば→巻く：02418_maku⟧、おにぎり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来上|できあ}がり→出来上がり：21122_dekiagari⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Wet your hands with salt, shape the rice into a triangle, put salmon in the middle, and wrap it in seaweed, and the rice ball is done.

notes:
Also called ⟦お{結|むす}び→おむすび：10247_omusubi⟧ or ⟦{握|にぎ}り{飯|めし}→握り飯：noentry⟧. Shapes vary by region:
- ⟦{三角|さんかく}→三角：04177_sankaku⟧ (triangle) - most common, standard in Kanto
- ⟦{俵型|たわらがた}→俵型：noentry⟧ (cylinder) - common in Kansai
- ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (round) - various regions

Common fillings (⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧):
- ⟦{梅干|うめぼ}し→梅干し：13110_umeboshi⟧ (pickled plum)
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧/しゃけ (salmon)
- ⟦{昆布|こんぶ}→昆布：04934_konbu⟧ (kelp)
- ⟦{鮪|まぐろ}→鮪：11134_maguro⟧/ツナマヨ (tuna mayo)
- ⟦{明太子|めんたいこ}→明太子：12729_mentaiko⟧ (spicy cod roe)
- ⟦おかか→おかか：noentry⟧ (bonito flakes with soy sauce)

A portable, affordable food popular for lunch (⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧), picnics, and convenience store snacks. The wrapper (⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧) keeps the rice moist.
